name: SurveyVersion
description: Immutable snapshot of a survey form taken when the survey is published. Submissions are validated and scored against these snapshots, never the live form config, so historical results stay accurate.

fields.description: Snapshot of the form's fields array at publish time

pages.description: Snapshot of the form's pages array at publish time

visibility_rules.description: Snapshot of the form's conditional-logic rules at publish time

survey_settings.description: Snapshot of the form's survey_settings at publish time

published_by.description: Email of the admin who published this version
